title: LocalFlow rewrite request v1
description: Body of POST /v1/rewrite. No other field is permitted; servers reject unknown fields with invalid_request. Byte limits (text <= 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, body <= 262,144 bytes) are enforced before parsing.

request_id.description: Attempt id, unique per attempt; echoed in every event.

text.description: 1 to 20,000 Unicode scalars, not blank, at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.

language_hints.description: Advisory BCP-47 tags; never a translation request.
